title: The Attraction Interview
hook: First, what caught you. Then a Tuesday. Then the old theory of chemistry you have retired. Both of you are interviewed.
steps: A coin picks who starts. Eight minutes, in that order, and all three get asked. Complicated, plus one true part, is a complete answer.
Include one detail that remains with the lights off: a sound, humor, or an action. Sexual detail is optional.
Two follow-ups, and no grade. Ask what you notice now that you could not name then. Thank them. Swap, so both answer.
Each of you names one sentence you want kept. No rebuttal, and no score.
ending: Nothing is booked. Sorting yes, no, and maybe is another evening unless you both want that now.
pass: Pass, pause, or change the question. You owe no history of other lovers, and no comment on a face.
safety: A body comment may be redirected, and the redirect ends it. Desire is not owed. Do not schedule sex to prove the interview worked.

title: The Yes, No, Maybe Game
hook: Sort alone. Four lanes: romantic, affectionate, sensual, and sexual. Compare only the stars.
steps: Rules first. A blank is not a shy yes. A short game may drop sensual and sexual and is still a whole game.
Star up to five yeses and three nos to make known. Unstarred nos stay unseen. A starred no is not a debate.
One starred item at a time. The listener says heard, or asks one question, then stops. Maybe is not consent.
At most one easy shared yes, if both still want it. You still ask, and nothing else is scheduled. Or none.
ending: A starred yes on paper is not the moment. If the gap hurts, skip that yes and end.
pass: Pass any lane. Hidden nos stay hidden. If anyone is intoxicated, play another night.
safety: A game result is not consent to touch or sex. Ask again in the room. A safer-sex no stays a no. Others stay off the sheet.

title: The Sensory Date
hook: Sound, scent, texture, taste, and light, in that order. Touch only where both of you have marked it welcome.
steps: Choose materials together. Sex is off the map unless both put it on before you start. Name each channel off or on, never maybe.
Each hosts one channel. A third may be quiet background. Do not demonstrate an unchosen channel. Offer, then wait.
Yes, smaller, or no. A no retires that station. The date continues. One yes does not start the next.
Restate welcome touch and wait. They set pressure and place. None means skip touch and stay.
ending: Name one thing to repeat. Sex on the map still needs a present yes. Momentum is not that yes.
pass: Scent is opt-in. Apart, the same music and tea are not a touch station.
safety: Hands do not replace a declined station. Stop ends it. Named desire is not a sequel.

title: The Desire Nobody Asked About
hook: One wish nobody asked about. It is allowed to remain a wish. Hearing it is not a yes.
steps: Agree the order before anyone shares. Write first: an unasked affection, a fantasy that may stay imaginary, or a closeness you usually edit out.
Read it at the size you wrote. If you start shrinking it, finish the sentence or pass the turn.
Then the listener stops after three moves: restate it and allow a correction, appreciate the telling, and say hearing this is not a yes.
One mark: tell only, maybe another day, or please do not ask me to do this. No haggling. Then switch.
ending: Tell only stays out of later flirtation. A maybe waits for its owner. A smaller wish still counts.
pass: Pass a lane or the session. If they go quiet, ask. Silence is not assent.
safety: Do not solve it. A wish is not a debt. A third person, or humiliation, stays tell only. Later sex needs its own yes.

title: The Slow Dance With No Music
hook: Sway in silence. No music, and no steps to get right.
steps: Before touch, agree three minutes or up to eight. Name form and ceiling. Hands-only, a chair, or lying down count. If you differ, use the smaller.
Rehearse the stop: two squeezes and a release, or the word pause, then step back. Say who leads first, or that nobody does.
A tap to switch the lead is not a new invitation. Be quiet, move small, and skip the posture notes. No surprise song.
The stop ends the dance. Only the person who stopped may ask to restart. Separate by a hand's width before you speak.
ending: Ask what you noticed, or skip the talk. Either one finishes the dance.
pass: You may skip the dance. An early stop is finished, and it creates no debt.
safety: A sway is not consent to sex. Arousal is not an instruction. The ceiling may drop at once. It rises only if you stop, speak, and both agree.
